timing.order: 10-case order reverses on odd rounds and rotates by round; target order also reverses and rotates
timing.boundary: in-page performance.now(): first of 768 input custom-property writes through score-offset/group writes and forced final/exact geometry
timing.excludes: page load, fonts.ready, one-time CSS injection, support/correctness checks, route bookkeeping, warmups, and Playwright round trips

cssOnlyConstraint: JavaScript injects each variant stylesheet once before timing and mutates inputs; CSS alone computes route and winner.

variants.label: Current conditional display:none/grid
Conditional content-visibility:hidden/visible; stage stays grid
Conditional visibility:hidden/visible; stage stays grid

fullScreenTransitionProjection.assumption: Consecutive routes are independent and measured transition medians transfer to the full-screen route mix.
